title: Executive Assistant
company: Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant
Location: Hull
Salary: £35,000 - £38,000 per annum

Make an impact at the heart of a successful professional services business
Consortium Professional Recruitment are pleased to be working with an established and respected professional services organisation to recruit an Executive Assistant. This newly created position offers the opportunity to work closely with the Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team, providing trusted support while helping the wider business stay organised, connected and effective.
This is a varied role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, managing competing priorities and being a dependable point of support. You will combine executive assistance with wider business coordination, working across administration, communications, recruitment, events and external supplier relationships.
The Opportunity:
As an Executive Assistant, you ll play a key role in:
- Providing proactive and confidential support to the Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team, including selected strategic matters.
- Preparing high-quality reports, presentations, meeting papers and action trackers.
- Coordinating projects, business administration, audio typing, document production and secretarial cover.
- Supporting internal communications and business planning, helping information and actions move effectively across the organisation.
- Coordinating external marketing, PR, website and design suppliers, alongside client and staff events, recruitment, onboarding, AML and GDPR administration.

Your work will directly contribute to stronger organisation, greater leadership capacity and effective day-to-day business operations.
About You:
We re looking for someone who can bring:
- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, PA or in a senior business support position.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively and coordinate varied activities.
- Clear and confident communication skills, together with a professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.
- Strong Microsoft 365 skills and previous audio typing experience.
- A proactive, dependable approach and the confidence to take ownership of tasks while working collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.

Experience within professional services would be beneficial, although it is not essential.
The Benefits and Package:
In return, you ll enjoy:
- £35,000 - £38,000 per annum.
- 37.5 hours per week.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- A newly created role with the opportunity to provide meaningful support across leadership and wider business activities.

How to Apply:
This exciting Executive Assistant opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach. If you re ready to take the next step in your career, we d love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.
Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. We regularly receive large responses to our advertising which can make providing individual feedback to every applicant challenging. title: Sales Administrator
company: Get Staffed Online Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sales Administrator

Are you organised, ambitious and naturally proactive

Do you enjoy speaking with customers, solving problems and making things happen

Are you looking for a role where your ideas, effort and results are noticed and where you can genuinely grow with the business

Have you had at least two years' experience in a business admin or similar customer facing role

If so, our client would like to hear from you.

Our client is a growing, forward-thinking family business operating within the automotive and heavy machinery sectors.

They work with a wide range of vehicles and plant machinery, providing high-quality installation services to customers across the UK and beyond.

As they continue to expand, they are looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded Sales Administrator to become a key part of their team.

What They Offer:
- Basic salary of £25,000 - £32,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Performance-based bonus scheme.
- Career development and progression opportunities.
- Early finish every Friday.
- Corporate clothing supplied.
- Christmas and New Year shutdown.
- Your birthday off.
- Additional holiday entitlement for long service.
- A supportive, energetic and growing team environment.
- The opportunity to make a visible contribution to the future success of the business.

Hours:
- 39.5 hours per week
- Monday - Thursday: 8:00am - 5:00pm
- Friday: 8:00am - 2:00pm
- This is an office-based position, and you will be required to work from the office five days per week
- Holiday: 28 days per annum

The Role

This is not a role for someone who simply wants to process paperwork and just follow a routine.

Our client is looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, spotting what needs to be done and getting involved. Someone who communicates confidently, learns quickly and takes pride in helping both customers and colleagues succeed.

If you like being busy, enjoy responsibility and want the opportunity to develop your career as the company grows, you could be a great fit.

You will play an important part in supporting their sales operation, looking after customers and helping the team achieve its commercial objectives.

Alongside supporting the wider sales team, you will also have the opportunity to work towards your own sales targets and develop your commercial skills.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing and producing customer quotations.
- Processing a high volume of customer and product orders accurately and efficiently.
- Taking and managing orders by telephone and email.
- Speaking confidently with customers and building strong, long-term working relationships.
- Handling customer enquiries, questions and complaints professionally.
- Following up quotations, opportunities and customer requirements.
- Liaising with external companies and suppliers to help ensure deliveries run smoothly.
- Keeping customers updated and proactively communicating throughout the order process.
- Sharing important customer feedback and commercial information with the wider team.
- Supporting the sales team with day-to-day operations and helping the team achieve its objectives.
- Taking ownership of your workload and prioritising the tasks that matter most.
- Looking for opportunities to improve the customer experience and the way our client works.

The Person They're Looking For

You may already be an experienced Sales Administrator, or you may have developed strong customer-facing and commercial skills in another role. What matters most to them is your attitude, capability and willingness to learn.

You are likely to thrive if you:
- Have at least 2 years' experience in a customer-facing, sales or client-focused role.
- Are confident and professional when speaking with customers on the telephone.
- Have a positive, proactive and solution-focused attitude.
- Take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
- Are commercially aware and motivated by achieving results.
- Learn quickly and adapt well to new systems, products and processes.
- Are highly organised and capable of managing several priorities at once.
- Communicate clearly, professionally and promptly.
- Have strong attention to detail.
- Are comfortable using modern IT systems and CRM software.
- Work well independently while also being a genuine team player.
- Enjoy being part of a growing business where everyone is prepared to contribute.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, our client will support you to develop a strong understanding of their company, their customers and their day-to-day operations.

Successful team members will:
- Build trusted relationships with customers.
- Deliver consistently excellent customer service, including during busy periods.
- Respond quickly and proactively to customers and colleagues.
- Keep customers informed rather than waiting for them to chase.
- Produce accurate quotes and process orders efficiently.
- Plan their workload effectively and meet agreed deadlines.
- Contribute positively to sales performance and team objectives.
- Look for better, smarter and more efficient ways of doing things.
- Become someone the wider team can rely on.

Ready for Your Next Challenge

Our client wants people to build careers with themselves, not simply fill positions.

They offer the opportunity to join an ambitious business at an exciting stage of its growth, where good ideas are welcomed and strong performance is recognised.

For the right person, this role offers genuine scope to take on more responsibility and progress as the business continues to expand.

Their recruitment process is designed to identify motivated, capable people who will thrive and build a successful career with them.

title: Quotations & Estimating Coordinator
description:
Are you an experienced Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Costing Coordinator or Commercial Coordinator looking for your next opportunity within a manufacturing business in the Hull area?

Do you enjoy working with detailed information, building accurate quotations and making sure every element of a customer requirement has been properly costed?

If so, this Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job in Hull could be a really good next step.

Our client is an established manufacturing business with a strong reputation for producing bespoke solutions for its customers. Due to a recent change within the team, they are now looking for a Quotations & Estimating Coordinator to join their Commercial department.

You ll be working closely with Account Management, Commercial and operational teams, turning customer requirements into accurate, competitive quotations. It s a role that needs someone who enjoys detail, understands how costs come together and can manage a busy workload without losing accuracy.

What the Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job involves

You ll be responsible for producing accurate and timely customer quotations, taking into account all of the different elements required to deliver each project.
- Producing accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Reviewing customer briefs and information supplied by the Account Management team.
- Calculating costs across areas such as materials, design work, labour, production time and other associated costs.
- Creating bespoke quotations based on individual customer requirements.
- Prioritising estimates according to customer needs and commercial deadlines.
- Supporting Account Management and Business Development with quotations for both new and existing customers.
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and colleagues across the wider business where further information is required.
- Maintaining accurate information within the company s CRM and estimating systems.
- Helping to ensure consistency across pricing and estimating processes.

The role plays an important part in supporting both existing customers and new business opportunities.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with numbers and detailed information, and takes real pride in accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within estimating, quotations, costing, pricing, commercial coordination or a similar role.
- Experience within manufacturing, print, packaging, engineering or another production environment would be advantageous.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence working with detailed cost information.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong data processing and analytical skills.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills and confidence liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments.
- A structured and process-driven approach.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Experience using CRM or estimating software would be beneficial.
- A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across the team.

We are particularly looking for someone who is accurate, adaptable, able to work under pressure and comfortable managing changing priorities.

You may currently be working as a Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Cost Estimator, Manufacturing Estimator, Commercial Coordinator, Pricing Coordinator, Costing Coordinator, Sales Estimator or Commercial Estimator and be looking for your next opportunity in the Hull area.

Other information
- Hours: 9.00am 5.30pm
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to buy up to five additional days.
- Auto-enrolment pension.
- Regular company events and social activities throughout the year.
- Free on-site parking.
- Christmas Eve and New Year s Eve early finish, subject to business requirements.
- Opportunity to join an established manufacturing business with a strong emphasis on integrity, teamwork and sustainability.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive, if you have not heard from us within two weeks, please assume you have not been shortlisted for this particular role.

title: Part Time Sales Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Part Time Sales Administrator to join our team temporary-to-permanent basis and provide essential support across the sales function. This is a varied and fast-paced role, responsible for ensuring customer orders, enquiries and sales opportunities are managed accurately and efficiently, while maintaining high-quality CRM and sales data. Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance, you will play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience, supporting the smooth progression of orders and helping the wider team achieve its commercial objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring all information is recorded correctly.
- Prepare and issue quotations, sales orders, and other sales documentation.
- Manage the HubSpot CRM, including deal creation, uploads, allocation, maintenance, and ensuring customer records remain accurate and up to date.
- Allocate inbound enquiries and sales opportunities to the appropriate sales representatives in accordance with company processes.
- Maintain customer records, pricing information, contacts, and sales data across company systems.
- Monitor sales pipelines and support the sales team by ensuring CRM data is accurate, complete, and up to date.
- Act as a primary point of contact for customer enquiries, providing timely and professional support.
- Liaise with operations, logistics, finance, and the sales team to ensure the smooth progression of customer orders and projects.
- Monitor order progress and communicate updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
- Identify and resolve customer or operational issues, escalating where appropriate.
- Produce routine sales reports and CRM data to support management reporting and business performance.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO9001 procedures, and service standards.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales administration processes, CRM data quality, and customer experience.
- Undertake any other reasonable duties requested by the Business Operations Manager or Executive Directors.

KEY ATTRIBUTES
- Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Customer-focused with a proactive approach to problem solving.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
- Strong administrative and data management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems, preferably HubSpot.
- Competent in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
- Reliable, professional, and committed to delivering a high standard of work.
- Able to work collaboratively across multiple departments.

title: Account Coordinator
description:
Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator)

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,700 per annum
Hours: 40 hours per week
Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activities by sourcing and coordinating suitable candidates.
- Conduct candidate registrations and onboarding processes.
- Deliver worker inductions and site briefings.
- Complete compliance checks, right-to-work verification, and employment documentation.
- Maintain accurate records using Stafforce's internal systems and databases.
- Update and manage workforce data using Microsoft Excel and other software packages.
- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
- Travel between client sites and offices as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong IT and administrative skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident using databases, software systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- A flexible and positive approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in recruitment, account coordination, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
- Experience working with temporary workers or high-volume staffing environments.
- Full UK driving licence due to travel requirements across multiple client locations in the Hull area.

What You'll Receive

In return, Stafforce offers a supportive environment where you can develop your career and make a real difference to both candidates and clients.

Benefits Include:
- Competitive salary of 27,700 per annum.
- Full training and ongoing development opportunities.
- Career progression within a well-established and growing business.
- 24/7 GP access through our employee wellbeing programme.
- Emotional wellbeing and mental health support.
- High street discounts across a wide range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers, and services.
- Access to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

S15

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

About the role

We are looking for an organised, proactive and personable Team Administration Assistant to provide practical administrative support across our practice.

This is a varied administration role supporting our accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams. The purpose of the position is to take ownership of the important day-to-day administrative tasks that keep client work moving, records up to date and our teams organised.

This is not an accountancy or tax position and we are not looking for someone with an accounting background. We are looking for someone who enjoys administration, is organised, gets things done and is happy helping different members of a busy team.

Key responsibilities

The role will include:

Accounts and client administration

Logging new accounts jobs and other work onto our systems.

Keeping job records and internal systems up to date.

Chasing clients for accounting records and other information.

Chasing signed accounts and Companies House documents, including confirmation statements.

Assisting with monthly accounts and bookkeeping job updates.

Maintaining and organising electronic client records and folders.

Processing changes to client details.

Sending clients copies of documents and information when requested.

Tax and MTD administration

Assisting with administrative data entry relating to Making Tax Digital.

Logging Self Assessment checklists and information returned by clients.

Scanning and saving tax working papers and client documents.

Sending copies of SA302s, previous tax returns and other documents requested by clients.

Providing general administrative support to the tax team, particularly during busy periods.

Practice and team administration

Assisting with monthly reviews of client fixed fees.

Assisting with quarterly reviews of bookkeeping and payroll fixed fees.

Sorting, scanning and processing incoming post.

Maintaining electronic post folders and filing.

Scanning, saving and organising client documents.

Providing administrative cover when other members of the team are absent.

Helping the accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams with routine administrative tasks.

Taking ownership of agreed recurring administrative tasks and making sure they are completed on time.

Credit control

Assisting with routine credit control.

Monitoring outstanding client balances.

Sending agreed payment reminders.

Following up outstanding amounts where required.

Keeping credit control records up to date.

About you

Previous office or administrative experience would be useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in finding someone with the right attitude and approach.

We are looking for someone who is:
- organised and able to manage a number of different tasks;
- proactive and willing to find the next job rather than always waiting to be asked;
- reliable and conscientious;
- friendly, approachable and confident speaking to people;
- comfortable communicating with clients by telephone and email;
- accurate and attentive to detail;
- comfortable using computers and learning different systems;
- willing to ask questions when unsure;
- able to handle confidential information appropriately;
- happy working as part of a team; and
- willing to help different areas of the practice when required.

What we're looking for

The right person will enjoy being the person who keeps things organised and makes sure things get done.

There will be a mixture of regular responsibilities and ad-hoc tasks, so we're looking for somebody who can spot what needs doing, take ownership of it and see it through.

Although you will work closely with our accountants and tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams, this is an administration role rather than a training position for an accountancy or tax career.

We want someone who is happy to build their knowledge of how our practice operates and become a reliable source of administrative support across the business.

title: Material Planner/Administrator
description:
Material Planner

Location: Goole

Duration: 6 Months

Pay Rate: 16.36 per hour PAYE

Hours per week:

40 hours per week

Flexible hours (8am-4pm or 9am-5pm)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and proactive Material Planner to join a dynamic supply chain and operations team. This is a pivotal role responsible for driving material demand planning, forecasting accuracy, and inventory optimisation across multiple projects and operational programmes.

Working closely with stakeholders across operations, commercial, project management, procurement, and supply chain functions, you will ensure materials are forecasted, planned, and scheduled effectively to support business requirements while maintaining optimal inventory levels. You will play a key role in improving forecasting methodologies, enhancing planning processes, and supporting the transition towards greater automation and efficiency within the planning function.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex planning challenges, and influencing operational performance through effective material management.

Key Responsibilities
Material Forecasting & Demand Planning
- Develop, maintain and continuously improve material demand planning and forecasting processes.
- Analyse demand signals and business requirements to create accurate and supportable material forecasts.
- Work cross-functionally to understand inventory management systems and processes across the business.
- Ensure forecasting methodologies and planning systems are effectively utilised to deliver high levels of forecast accuracy.
- Support the ongoing development and optimisation of planning tools and processes.

Materials Planning & Scheduling
- Plan and schedule material requirements to support operational activities and project delivery programmes.
- Coordinate with operational teams, project managers, overhaul managers, and materials control functions to ensure material availability aligns with business needs.
- Identify potential supply risks, escalate issues appropriately, and recommend mitigation actions.
- Validate and maintain material delivery plans and associated purchase requirements.
- Conduct root cause analysis on material shortages or planning issues and support effective resolution.

Integrated Material Planning
- Support the coordination of material planning activities across the wider supply chain and operational value chain.
- Collaborate with planning, operations, inventory management, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment of forecasts and material requirements.
- Contribute to integrated business planning (IBP) and sales, inventory and operations planning (SIOP) activities.

Reporting & Performance Management
- Monitor and produce key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure planning effectiveness and forecasting accuracy.
- Develop and maintain reports that support planning decisions and provide visibility to stakeholders.
- Communicate planning insights and recommendations clearly to all levels of the organisation.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, planning processes, and inventory performance.
- Support the implementation of best practices, planning methodologies, and system enhancements.
- Work with internal and external stakeholders to maximise the effectiveness of ERP and planning systems.
- Provide recommendations to leadership that drive operational efficiency and business performance.

Health, Safety & Compliance
- Adhere to all company health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Promote a strong safety culture through personal accountability and active participation in safety initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant policies, procedures, and business conduct requirements.

Key Stakeholder Relationships

You will work closely with:
- Operations Leadership Teams
- Commercial Teams
- Project Managers
- Supply Chain & Procurement Teams
- Inventory Management Teams
- Planning & Forecasting Functions
- Senior Business Stakeholders

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Strong analytical, data interpretation, and problem-solving skills.
- Proven experience in material planning, demand planning, forecasting, or supply chain planning environments.
- Experience supporting or leading IBP and/or SIOP processes.
- Knowledge of inventory management principles and best practices.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to confidently present information and recommendations at all levels of an organisation.
- Strong numeracy and data analysis capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of supply chain performance drivers.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Commitment to health, safety, and compliance standards.

Desirable
- Experience with ERP, forecasting, and planning systems.
- Advanced data analysis and reporting skills.
- Knowledge of inventory optimisation techniques and service level management.
- Experience working within complex operational or engineering environments.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented planner with a passion for data, forecasting, and continuous improvement. You will be comfortable working across multiple stakeholders, managing competing priorities, and using analytical insight to influence decision-making. If you thrive in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoy driving efficiencies through effective planning, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to play a key role in shaping material planning performance and supporting the successful delivery of critical operational programmes.

All PPE provided by the client and Health and Safety explained before and on site.

title: Market Research Coordinator
description:
Market Research Coordinator

Location: Brandesburton
Salary: £30,000 + benefits
Recruiting on behalf of: A well-established and highly regarded organisation

The Opportunity

We are working with a well-known organisation based in Brandesburton to recruit a Market Research Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied role supporting the Business Development & Analytics function, with a strong focus on market research, data, CRM management and business intelligence. You will play an important part in ensuring the team has accurate and relevant information to identify new opportunities, support sales activity and make informed commercial decisions.

The role also offers the opportunity to embrace AI technology, using emerging tools to improve research, data management and the quality of business insights.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct market and competitor research to identify potential business opportunities.
- Research and maintain accurate information relating to prospects, customers, markets and sectors.
- Manage and update CRM records, ensuring information is complete, accurate and kept up to date.
- Gather and analyse data to support lead generation and business development activity.
- Provide the wider team with relevant market intelligence and research findings.
- Identify and monitor relevant industry frameworks and opportunities for the business.
- Use AI tools to enhance research, improve efficiency and support data analysis.
- Help maintain high standards of data quality across business systems.
- Produce reports and information to support commercial and strategic decision-making.
- Work closely with colleagues across Business Development, Sales and Analytics to provide effective research and administrative support.

About You

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, analytical and highly organised, with a genuine interest in understanding markets and using data to identify opportunities.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within business development, sales support, market research, data administration, marketing or a similar role.
- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining large volumes of business data.
- Strong research and information-gathering skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to spot inaccuracies.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A methodical approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- An interest in developing your knowledge and practical use of AI tools and technology.

If you're a data-driven, commercially curious individual looking for a role where your research and analytical skills can make a genuine difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to employ a part time Receptionist to join our friendly team. The successful candidate will be required to provide effective and efficient reception and administrative services for the practice in a professional and courteous manner. Experienced in delivering a high standard of customer service is valued but full training for this role will be provided. The role is for 16 hours per week to cover maternity leave for 12 months . Also there is a need to be able to cover colleagues for sickness and holiday absence. Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice, including the provision clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Ensure efficient running of appointment system. Be aware of flow of patients into consulting rooms and advise patients regarding any potential delays. Help coordinate urgent on the day appointments for patients either by assisting with the online forms or walk-in emergencies. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and other visitors. Participate in Care Navigation, which involves signposting patient to more appropriate health care services. Take and process new patient registrations. Safely take samples from patients as per the Sample Handing protocol. Take subject access requests from patients. Set up online user accounts. Ensure that you are familiar with the appointment systems being used for the practice and Primary Care Network appointments. Book appointments for long term condition recalls as per the patients needs. Process patient information such as notifications of deaths as per practice protocols. Receive and transfer telephone calls. Ensure accurate messages are transcribed to the relevant recipient. To assist with the Practices clerical work as required. This may involve clinical data entry onto the computer, scanning of documents, issuing mail-merge letters, recording and extracting data for audit purposes. To retrieve and advise patients of their tests results. To provide holiday and sickness cover for colleagues as required. This list is not exhaustive and other duties relative to the role may apply.

description: We have an exciting opportunity for a Clinical Team Administrator to join the Mental Health team based in HMP Hull. This is a fantastic opportunity to join and support our multi-disciplinary team who work closely together to give the best holistic care to our patients. In this role, you will be based in the prison working closely amongst the team which means hybrid working is not supported. This role is subject to Prison Vetting, and the successful candidate must pass this before commencing employment. This includes a thorough review of personal information, including a criminal record check (both spent and unspent), a review of financial standing, and social media checks. Please note that vetting checks may also extend to family members and associates. You must also have resided in the UK for 3 years at the point of application. This will be considered as part of the shortlisting criteria, and your application may be rejected if you do not meet this criteria. You must have the Right to Work in the UK in order to be successfully appointed to this role. Please note, this role does not meet the required eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa and therefore the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular role. We are looking for a skilled individual who has experience working in an administrative role to support the unit to achieve and maintain high standards of clinical excellence. The successful candidate is required to have: a Diploma/NVQ Level 3 in Business Administration or equivalent (or willingness to achieve within an agreed timescale) ITQ Level 2 qualification or equivalent (or willingness to achieve within an agreed timescale) Key skills in literacy and numeracy level 2 or (GCSE grade C and above). The post involves providingadministrative duties to support the multi-disciplinary team. The successful candidate will need to have excellent IT and organisational skills and a good knowledge and understanding of information systems. Secretarial/administrative experience is essential along with comprehensive knowledge and experience within Microsoft office applications. SystmOne experience would be an advantage although training will be provided. The team is busy and fast paced so the ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines with a flexible and motivated attitude to work is essential. The role includes day to day admin tasks such as organising meetings, answering the phone, attending team huddles, monitoring a shared inbox and minuting of clinical meetings. Dictation may also be required to support clinical staff. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written coupled with proven secretarial skills and previous experience is essential. Our organisation is on a 'Journey to Change' and as part of this journey, creating a great experience for our staff is one of three big goals. Ultimately our aim is to be a proactive, responsible and mindful employer, recruiting, retaining and training our people, for the right roles, at the right time. Informal discussions and visits are welcomed, please contact Sophie Kirk 01642 838292. This job advert may close early if a high volume of applications have been received.
